summary.text: Bubba Sorensen, listed on the Iowa Legislature's site as Ray Sorensen, is a Republican who represents District 23 in the Iowa House of Representatives and is listed as serving a fourth term.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography describes Sorensen as a small business owner, mural artist, photographer and graphic designer, and as a Freedom Rock artist.
It says Sorensen attended DMACC and Iowa State University, was born in 1979 in Creston and lives in Greenfield.
